scientific_question: Can class-prior or decision-threshold mismatch explain the near-chance GossipCop balanced accuracy?
target_construct: prediction of supplied GossipCop binary corpus labels from ISOT-trained title scores; not claim-level truth

threshold_free_metric.uncertainty: 2000 class-stratified bootstrap resamples preserving class sizes

full_sample_oracle.interpretation: descriptive in-sample upper bound only; not an external-performance estimate

disjoint_target_adaptation.evaluation: paired adapted and locked predictions on the identical disjoint remainder
disjoint_target_adaptation.platt_sensitivity: near-unregularized one-dimensional logistic sigmoid fitted only on adaptation margins; evaluation threshold probability 0.5
disjoint_target_adaptation.reported_uncertainty: mean, sample standard deviation, and 2.5th-97.5th percentiles across repeated splits
disjoint_target_adaptation.percentile_limit: split-stability percentiles are not sampling confidence intervals

evidential_status: exploratory post-hoc sensitivity; not preregistered, confirmatory, or an independent external test
interpretation_limit: The analysis tests simple threshold and Platt corrections and does not rule out richer supervised domain adaptation.
